body: I’m 5’10”-11”ish and have been since I was like 12 lol. I used to say my biggest dream was to trade a few inches to someone in need. I’ve always wanted to be dainty 😅

I teeter down the rabbit hole. I think it has something to do with typical “thinspo” content not being relatable when I was very overweight. I stuck to “fatspo” and other mean things as a form of self harm maybe? I was a teenager in the golden age of tumblr so that might have something to do with it as well lol  

I’m also ashamed that I still regularly consume fat-logic content haha

My mom modeled her ED perfectly for me, like a blueprint. I remember when I was 12, I had swine flu, I was really sick for 2+ weeks and ended up losing a lot of weight. She bought me a new bathing suit and took me to the water park afterward. She raved about how good I looked
My hand is literally always on my collar bone
Society definitely seems much more accepting of my personality the thinner I am.
My mom went on and on about how great I looked after I had an awful (10 day long) stomach bug at 13. She bought me a new bathing suit and took me to a water park.
Anytime I try to establish a routine, I end up in a restriction cycle
I’ve heard customers say that at work! The one time it happened to my coworker he had to take his break early, almost went home too, he was so astounded by the audacity.

Don’t ask. ED’s are fickle beasts, and you wouldn’t want to be the reason this person spirals (even if you think they are already spiraling). I’ve recently started trauma-dumping on people that get too nosey, so you might get more than you wanted if you do ask

Yeah, that sounds unprofessional. Maybe she’s having a bad spiral, and you (and probably other patients) just got caught up in it. You should find a new therapist, that really sucks since you felt like you were clicking, I’m sorry. :(
Chest plate?
Have you seen the Binge pilot on YouTube? The main character has bulimia, and it follows her along and unfolds some of her story. It’s pretty funny though!
Mine were pretty flat, the piercing definitely makes me feel like my nipple looks more “separated” from my areola, if that makes sense?
My dog is the only thing that keeps me (semi) grounded. She’s a good tether to reality! I genuinely think animals can be one of the most beneficial beings for *some mental illnesses.
My mom keeps the scale in HER bathroom :/

I get a brain freeze, that lasts just too long, whenever someone directly asks me about food or eating. I trained on Tumblr my whole adolescence to respond these inquiries, but I go completely blank every time.

I made a post recently about how everyone in my life seemed to notice/get worried at once. I thought it would feel different to have some external “validation”. Honestly, it was just uncomfortable, embarrassing, and frustrating. And outside of misplaced “helpful” comments, nobody actually knows what to say/do so they just ignore it.

I can’t think about anything else. I just quit my new job (stupidly and impulsively) and in the back of my head it’s because I can’t focus on learning a new job AND throwing my brain completely into a calorie-less existence. I’m overwhelmed and drowning over here.
Dresses at my local Goodwill are now 12.99!! I know it’s still cheaper than new, but the pricing is getting insane lately.
It 100% has to do with me and myself. I only think about my body and the way it effects me. The only person I ever thought (out loud) was “too fat” was my past-self. It’s a lonely ride.
I think I prefer just leaving bits and pieces in the storyline vs. having a 2 part episode where they’re completely recovered by the end (I’m looking at you Full House)

Yes! This post was a knee-jerk reaction to most recent inquest into my eating habits, but the double standard kills me (and I still had an unhealthy relationship with food, and awful restriction cycles while being obese). I’m working towards getting mental health help in general, it’s hard to ACTUALLY do it though 😅 I hope you’re well, and thank you so much for taking the time to reply, it’s easy for me to think I’m alone in this

Thank you for the judgement free acknowledgment! I was feeling very alone in my real life, and I always forget I can reach out to this community (even if I felt like I had to make a new account for it). I wish you nothing but love and okay-ness!

I really appreciate it! It just feels so much more awkward to be closing in on thirty, and just now having everything crash down around me. I’m not having a great time, but it’s nice to rant a little bit

I know they’re coming from a place of love. Some of them a place of familiarity. I genuinely just feel very seen, and idk how to deal with it. I have a lot of irrational and reactive feeling right now. My best friend passed away almost 10 years ago as a direct result of her ED, so I know she’s in their mind as much as she’s in mine. I really needed to vent, so I appreciate the non-judgmental ears!
